rightsProvenance.reviewPurpose: Source and rights provenance accuracy; not legal advice or a blanket reuse license determination.
rightsProvenance.officialNoticeAnnexBasis: Both MOIS pages identify the respective archive as [별표], and each legal notice article2 refers its reference prices to the annex. Korean Copyright Act article7(2) expressly names national/local government notices as unprotected works under that Act.
doNotInfer: Do not declare all MOIS site content or every ZIP member KOGL Type1 from the site's general policy.
Do not apply the notice/annex provenance statement to unrelated third-party pictures, trademarks, bundled Office metadata, or third-party sources.
Do not declare a separately downloaded remote official hash match when only locally supplied bytes have been hashed.
Do not merge source licensing with separately acquired commercial/provider/global datasets.
